title: feat(examples): 3 kind:'react' business-scenario showcase pages (ADR-0081)
body:
Three realistic kind:'react' showcase pages composing the real ListView + ObjectForm with React state: **Inquiry Triage** (status tabs+live counts filter a real ListView; row->detail with Mark Contacted/Close actions), **Account Cockpit** (live-search + ObjectForm edit + cross-object related strip projects/invoices/open-AR via useAdapter), **Invoice Console** (status-aggregation KPIs + segmented filter + create/edit + Mark Paid). Wired into showcase nav; os validate passes (incl ADR-0081 react syntax gate); 28 pages. Browser-verified end-to-end via objectui dev/sdui-scenarios-preview (paired objectui #2107).
